name: boj_get_exchange_rate
description:
Daily yen exchange rates from FRED, as Japanese yen per one unit of the other currency: usd_jpy is yen per US dollar (DEXJPUS, noon buying rate in New York); eur_jpy is yen per euro, derived as DEXJPUS x DEXUSEU on matching dates.
Returns: series_code (FRED id, or IMF flow.key), series_id, label, source, observation_count and observations (date, value) oldest first, missing values dropped. eur_jpy also carries units and a derived-rate source.
Inputs (none required): currency_pair (usd_jpy or eur_jpy; default usd_jpy); start_date, end_date (YYYY-MM-DD); recent_periods (1-500; default 10; the last N observations, used only when neither date is given).
For the ECB's euro reference rate use ecb_get_exchange_rate with EUR/JPY. FRED series need FRED_API_KEY (config fred.api.key); without it they fail with a message saying so.
Example: {"currency_pair": "usd_jpy", "recent_periods": 30}

currency_pair.description: Japanese yen per unit of the other currency: usd_jpy is yen per US dollar, eur_jpy yen per euro

recent_periods.description: The last N observations; used only when neither date is given
